qualification.details: Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences): Graduate degree in Life Sciences or an allied basic-science discipline relevant to biomedical research from a recognized university or institution. Young Professional-II (Information Technology): Postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, or Computer Graphics from a recognized university or institution, with a minimum of three years of post-qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICMR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICMR Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICMR Young Professional recruitment is 21 October 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Young Professional posts at the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). These are divided into Young Professional-I and Young Professional-II categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly via Email. Candidates need to prepare their bio-data and attach the necessary documents to send to the official email address provided in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category, including General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates. The application process is completely free of cost for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Young Professional-II (Information Technology) post will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Young Professional-I (Basic Sciences) post must possess a Graduate degree in Life Sciences or an allied basic-science discipline relevant to biomedical research from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ICMR recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves multiple stages, including Application Screening, a Written Test, a Skill Test, an Interview, and finally, Document Verification to ensure the candidate meets all the specified criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation for the applicants will be provided as per the government rules. Candidates should refer to the official notification for specific details regarding the relaxation applicable to their respective categories.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these Young Professional positions is in New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110029). Candidates should be prepared to work at the specified ICMR location.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the email?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of their educational certificates, experience certificates, valid ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs along with their detailed bio-data in the email application.
